newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was slow in the panhandle area late Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady in a light test.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 400 heifers; 18,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 15,400 formulated, 1,100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 10 loads or 400 head of CME cattle.
Confirmed: 1,400 Week Ago: None Year Ago: 102,300
Wk to Date: 18,800 Week Ago: 21,800 Year Ago: 117,600
